content.title: American Financial Group (AFG): Profit Margin Decline Reinforces Concerns Ahead of Earnings Season
content.summary: American Financial Group (AFG) reported net profit margins of 10%, a drop from 11.3% last year, signaling a year-over-year decline in profitability. Over the last five years, AFG achieved 4.2% annual growth in earnings, but more recently registered negative earnings growth. Heading into the next year, analysts expect 11.3% annual earnings growth for AFG, a pace that trails the broader US market’s 15.8% forecast.
